findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.75 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #d4622f, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
findings.note: The 'Book online' button has low contrast (3.75:1) between its white text and red background, making it hard to see for people with low vision or color blindness. This affects users who rely on visual cues to identify interactive elements.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the background color to a higher-contrast shade, such as #d32f2f (red), or use a darker background like #8d0000. The contrast ratio between #ffffff and #d32f2f is 4.5:1, which meets WCAG 2.2 AA requirements.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.47:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #ffffff, surrounding text: #cfd6d9)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
findings.note: The 'Privacy policy' link lacks visible distinction from surrounding text—its white color has a poor contrast (1.47:1) with the gray text, and it lacks an underline or other visual indicator, making it hard for users to tell it's a link.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an underline or a different font style (e.g., bold) to distinguish the link. For example, use a bold font weight (e.g., 600) or add a subtle underline. Ensure the text color has a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 with the surrounding text; using #ffffff against #cfd6d_ ensures 4.4:1 contrast, which meets the requirement.
